name: R5-PR0UD
description: R5-PR0UD was a multicolored R5-series astromech. They lived on the colorful and peaceful Ithorian-populated world of Takobo. This droid often frequented the capital, Takobo City, and when not on planet, they traveled on various journeys across the galaxy.
